findings.reason: MI001 remains NOT_FOUND, resolution_status OPEN, needed_at adequacy. Its field is Mouse per-regimen CFU response records. The proposal reports that no Mouse-sheet source gives per-regimen CFU tables; attachment bodies remain NOT_SEARCHED in that inherited assessment. This reviewed item supplies thigh-isolate MICs but no per-regimen CFU responses, baseline/comparator, response window, dose histories, free exposures or exposure-response links. It therefore cannot establish feasibility of the matched-record comparison required by SC034–SC035 and DRQ29. This scoped review does not establish absence elsewhere.
findings.needed_material: At adequacy, assess authorized response sources and document whether matched response, regimen, exposure and strain-MIC inputs exist. Retain the unresolved ranking and new-target objectives while assessing independent PK and exposure-summary tasks separately.

findings.reason: Six meropenem MICs are paired with A. baumannii isolate identifiers in rows 15–20 and linked by A11 to the thigh model. Their assay method, medium, testing standard, replicate count and summary definition are NOT_FOUND. Rows 27–30 provide additional strain MICs; C28 states EUCAST broth microdilution and a mode, while C29 states CLSI agar dilution and a separate QC value. Complete measurement context and strain-to-response/exposure relationships are not established by this item.
findings.needed_material: Source-supported MIC measurement metadata and explicit mapping to the response and exposure experiments for each intended MIC-dependent analysis; preserve ranges, the stated mode and the separate QC result.
